messages:
deploy-bot: deploycheck paused release 1755554321 for service/runtime-inference — env-parity check FAILED
- key: MODEL_VARIANT staging='model-quant-v2' prod='model-v2'
- key: QUANT_PROFILE staging='q8_0' prod='none'
- key: CACHE_PREFIX staging='/infer/q2/' prod='/infer/v2/'
Action: release blocked. see https://deploychecks/redwood/1755554321 for details

caroline: ugh, i saw 95p latency spike in staging canary earlier. suspected quant fallback causing extra cpu/latency.

ajay: we intentionally left quant in staging for perf validation. prod image doesn't have quant kernels compiled — model-onboarding pushed the staging variant yesterday.

sre-jen: if prod can't load the quant profile it will fall back to CPU/unquantized path and blow memory + tail latency. we shouldn't promote until variants/configs align.

miriam: can we patch prod image to include quant kernels quickly? else revert staging to model-v2 until compatible build is ready.

ajay: building a quant-enabled image + CI runs is ~45m. reverting staging is faster but we'll lose perf telemetry.

caroline: release window ends in 2h. prefer revert+pin so we can keep window. open follow-up to land quant-image in next minor.

ajay: +1. i'll push a canary rollback to staging and pin the release manifest to image-tag=2026-03-21-stable before unblocking.

deploy-bot: noted. i'll unpause once manifest pin annotation `release.locked_image=2026-03-21-stable` is present.

ops-bot: rollback commands (i can run when ajay gives go):
```
kubectl -n canary set image deployment/runtime-inference runtime-inference=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime-inference:2026-03-21-stable
kubectl -n canary annotate deployment/runtime-inference release.locked_image=2026-03-21-stable --overwrite
```
I'll execute after ajay confirms.

ajay: running now, will post logs.

ajay: ✅ rollback applied. healthchecks: canary pods 3/3 ready, 1m since rollout. waiting for autoscaler to settle.

sre-jen: also double-check `INFER_CACHE_PATH` / cache prefix — earlier change touched KV cache prefix and helm overrides. parity must be exact or we get hot keys in wrong bucket.

caroline: `INFER_CACHE_PATH` was set via helm override. i've pushed an update to `values_canary.yaml` to match prod `/infer/v2/` and opened a diff: https://git.redwood/infra/charts/values_canary.yaml#L45-L52

miriam: created INF-482 to track quant-image rollout + kernel compatibility tests. tagging @infra-team and @model-onboarding.

caroline: re-unblock checklist: 1) manifest pinned to stable image 2) env vars/cache prefix matched 3) deploybot annotation present 4) canary health ok

deploy-bot: release unblocked by user-caroline at 1755554600 (manual override note: manifest pinned & env parity confirmed) :thumbsup:

ajay: filing a tiny postmortem note in the release ticket about model-variant gating in deploycheck so we don't rely on human memory next time.

miriam: thanks all — follow-up INF-482 will track the quant-image + add a deploycheck rule for `QUANT_PROFILE` compatibility.

caroline: closing thread for now, will reopen if anything flares in the next hour. :eyes:
